description:
An award-winning, open-source video editor

OpenShot Video Editor is an award-winning, open-source video editor, available on Linux, Mac, Chrome OS, and Windows. OpenShot can create stunning videos, films, and animations with an easy-to-use interface and rich set of features.
Highlights & Features:
- Upgraded Razor tool with source-frame previews, snapping, removal shading, and ripple cuts that close gaps on the same track.
- Improved timeline navigation with persistent clip titles and effect controls, clearer zoom-slider handles, and more consistent thumbnails.
- Faster color and keyframe editing, more responsive trim previews, and smoother live transform adjustments.
- Fixed macOS startup failures caused by missing library dependencies on systems without Homebrew.
- Improved stability, undo/redo history, project saving, asset handling, and compatibility with older project layouts.
- Restored native file dialogs and improved Inkscape and Blender workflows, including access for editors installed as Snaps.
- Added non-interrupting announcement banners. Dismissed update notices stay hidden until the next release.
- Introduced official Linux Snap support with automatic updates and desktop menu integration.
- Improved recording workflows, Linux webcam discovery, and Windows recording-file handling.
- Refreshed interface and documentation translations in 25 languages, with clearer tooltips and improved video-editing terminology.
